description: This file contains the implementation of utility functions for managing cookies within the YUI (Yahoo! User Interface) library. It defines a YAHOO.util.Cookie object with methods for creating, parsing, retrieving, setting, and removing cookies and subcookies, including handling of cookie options such as expiration, path, domain, and security.

classes.name: Cookie
classes.description: A static class providing methods for cookie creation, retrieval, modification, and deletion within the YUI utility namespace.

methods.name: _createCookieString(name , value , encodeValue , options )
methods.description: Creates a cookie string with specified parameters, including optional attributes like expiration, path, domain, and security.

methods.name: _createCookieHashString(hash )
methods.description: Formats an object of key-value pairs into a string suitable for storing as a cookie value.

methods.name: _parseCookieHash(text )
methods.description: Parses a cookie hash string into an object containing individual key-value pairs.

methods.name: _parseCookieString(text , decode )
methods.description: Parses the complete document.cookie string into an object of cookie names and values.

methods.name: exists(name)
methods.description: Checks if a cookie with the specified name exists.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a cookie by name, optionally applying a converter function.

methods.name: getSub
methods.description: Retrieves a subcookie's value within a cookie that stores multiple key-value pairs.

methods.name: getSubs
methods.description: Returns an object of key-value pairs stored inside a specified cookie.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a cookie by setting its expiration date to the past.

methods.name: removeSub
methods.description: Removes a specific subcookie from a cookie that holds multiple key-value pairs.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a cookie with a specified name and value, along with optional attributes.

methods.name: setSub
methods.description: Sets a specific subcookie within a cookie containing multiple key-value pairs.

methods.name: setSubs
methods.description: Stores an object of key-value pairs inside a cookie.
